content:
The following table describes the fields for the managedassets event.
Field name
Description
Example value
aid
The sensor ID. This value is unique to each installation of a Falcon sensor. When a
sensor is updated or reinstalled, the host gets a new aid. In those situations, a single
host could have multiple aidvalues over time.
"85ae98xxxxxxd9a8f2"
cid
The customer ID.
0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV-WX
GatewayIP
The gateway of the system where the sensor is installed.
"10.10.10.1"
GatewayMAC
The MAC address of the gateway.
"00-00-5E-00-53-00"
InterfaceAlias
The user-friendly name of the IP interface.
"Local Area Network"
"Ethernet"
InterfaceDescription
The network adapter used for the IP interface.
"Intel(R) PRO/1000 MT Network
Connection"
LocalAddressIP4
The device's local IP address in IPv4 format.
"192.0.2.100"
MAC
The MAC address of the system.
"00-00-5E-00-53-00"
MACPrefix
An identifier unique to the organization.
"00-00-5E"
_time
The host's local time in epoch format.
"1538648887.051"
